name: Abhishek SEO
author: kibzzz

sections.description:
Abhishek SEO is a simple SEO plugin that helps generate SEO titles, meta descriptions, and keywords using AI.

How to Use

  1. Go to WordPress Dashboard
  2. Open any Post or Page
  3. Scroll down to “Abhishek SEO” meta box
  4. Click the “Generate SEO” button
  5. The plugin will generate:
    • SEO Title
    • Meta Description
    • Keywords

Features

  • AI SEO Suggestions
  • Meta Title Generator
  • Meta Description Generator
  • Keyword Suggestions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Where can I find the plugin?

You can find it inside the post/page editor.

Does it work automatically?

No, click the button to generate SEO suggestions.
